import html from typing import List # A minimal template for the forum post. The placeholders are used with str.format. USER_POST_FORMAT = ( '
\n' '
\n' '

{title}

\n' '

Posted by: {author_name}

\n' '
\n' '
{body}
\n' '
{tags}
\n' '
' ) def render_forum_post( author_name: str, title: str, body_content: str, tag_list: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Identifier of the user who created the post. title : str The heading of the user's post. body_content : str The main content of the post. tag_list : List[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string ready to be inserted into a page. Notes ----- All user supplied data is escaped with html.escape to neutralise any embedded markup or scripting. The tag list is rendered as a series of elements with the class "tag" for styling. """ # Escape all user provided strings safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_content, quote=False) # body may contain newlines # Render each tag inside a element, escaping the tag text safe_tags = ''.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)} ' for tag in tag_list ).strip() # Combine everything using the template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags )
